knowledge_gaps: The lexical encoder lacks reproducible settings: vocabulary construction, token limits, embedding dimensions, initialization, regularization, and missing-text handling.
LayerNorm can make the lexical residual large relative to small initialized ID embeddings despite gate initialization at -3; the claimed preservation of embedding scale needs verification.
A differentiable item_emb.weight property could repeatedly encode the entire catalog. Training cost, diagnostic memory use, and safe inference caching are unspecified.
Mean pooling discards relationships among attributes and may learn brand or token-overlap shortcuts. The report needs controlled ablations before attributing gains to specificity or compatibility.
Baseline validation HR@10, checkpoint-selection rules, and a search-budget allocation are missing. Training margins do not establish that Electronics offers the largest validation improvement.
Originality is reasonably described as incremental, but potential and implementation-difficulty ratings lack empirical support.

follow_up_queries.reason: Find evidence and ablations that distinguish useful lexical sharing from superficial similarity, while preserving one jointly trained HSTU model per category.
follow_up_queries.query: Sequential recommendation jointly trained item ID and mean pooled text embeddings from scratch without pretrained encoders: evidence for rare-item improvements, brand token shortcut learning, and ID-only versus text-residual ablations

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve residual scaling and catalog-encoding costs before implementing the embedding replacement and matching predictor.
follow_up_queries.query: PyTorch jointly trained ID plus text residual item embeddings: match LayerNorm residual scale to ID initialization, efficiently pool repeated item token embeddings, and cache catalog embeddings only during inference without stale gradients

follow_up_queries.reason: Define a credible validation-selection procedure within the fixed evaluator and GPU budget, without changing seeds, candidates, or accessing test outcomes.
follow_up_queries.query: Recommender evaluation sampled HR@10 with 99 negatives and 200 users per dataset: paired uncertainty estimation for fixed candidates, macro-average comparison, and validation overfitting from repeated checkpoint and hyperparameter selection
